item.title: Lilie James Was Stalked Before Her Killer Struck
item.description: After Lilie James ended their relationship, Paul Thijssen stalked her before killing her at a Sydney school in October 2023. A coronial inquest documented seven instances of physical stalking and evidence that he rehearsed the attack, revealing the planning behind the 21-year-old coach’s murder.

item.title: Antonio Brown Accused of Shoving Woman During Dispute
item.description: A January 2019 police report alleged that Antonio Brown pushed the mother of his daughter during an argument at his Hollywood home over reimbursement for their child’s hair appointment. Police investigated, but Brown was not arrested over the incident.

item.title: Kristin Smart Murder Conviction Came After 26 Years
item.description: Kristin Smart vanished in 1996 after a college party. In 2022, a jury convicted Paul Flores of her murder. Explore the decades of investigation and her family’s persistence that helped bring the case to trial, followed by a sentence of 25 years to life.

item.title: Roofman Hid in a Toy Store After Escaping Prison
item.description: Jeffrey Manchester earned the nickname Roofman by breaking into restaurants through their roofs. After escaping prison beneath a truck in 2004, he hid inside a Charlotte Toys R Us and an adjoining vacant store. A later robbery exposed his concealed living quarters and helped police track him down.

item.title: Frank Abagnale and the Claims Behind Catch Me If You Can
item.description: Frank Abagnale’s stories of impersonation and fraud inspired Catch Me If You Can. Later investigations challenged key parts of his account, using public records to question his timeline and claimed exploits as a pilot, doctor and lawyer.

item.title: Why Stanley Kubrick Became Part of a Moon Landing Conspiracy
item.description: An examination of the unfounded theory that Stanley Kubrick helped stage the Apollo Moon landings. Explores how his filmmaking, interpretations of The Shining and supposed clues became part of a conspiracy narrative, separating speculation from documented history.

item.title: Amanda Dean Was Missing but Her Family Was Told Otherwise
item.description: Amanda Dean disappeared from Ohio in 2017, but her family says the Huron County Sheriff’s Office told them she was safe. The case examines their push for answers, the investigation reopened in 2022 and questions about how authorities handled her disappearance.

item.title: Molly Young and the Fight for Answers About Her Death
item.description: Molly Young was found dead in her former boyfriend’s Carbondale apartment in March 2012. A coroner’s jury ruled the manner of death undetermined, and prosecutors found insufficient evidence to bring charges. Her family challenged the investigation and fought for access to case records.
